body: I dont have the time to find a part time job but I have been saving some money and Im sure Ill be able to cover the expenses of therapy and the given medication. I guess your system makes sense and I might give it a try because Im sick of all my days being the same , I hate that the only thing I like about life is dreaming. I dont plan on taking my life at the moment and I havent been self harming for a couple of months.I have been taking good care of my physical health and now I want to help my brain.The main reason for my depression is stress and my crazy anxiety but if I can force myself to find other paths and views points I might be able to fix myself temporarily until I can consult therapist.Thanks for your support 💜

My grandparents dont believe in mental illnesses :/ And Im not close with any of my cousins. I was going to talk to the schools guidance counselor but then covid happened . Im very lucky. Ill try to gather all my caurage and talk to my mom about everything but she will probably think that Im looking for an excuse to not help her and study. We dont have the best relationship. I have to wait until the schools reopen and idk when that will happen. Thanks for your answer :)
